verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs claim 'user permission management, access control lists' and repository collaborator management, so it does ship some permission controls. The evidence never shows these controls applying at each level the story names. Missing for 10: documented organization/team-level permissions, project-level permissions, branch-level protection rules, environment-level (e.g. Actions deployment environment) permissions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of granularity.
